results.note: Epigrammata sodalitatis litterariae (epigrams of a literary society) — no English translation found. Specialized collection of medieval Latin epigrams, not covered by standard patristic translation series.

Testimonia veterum de Aymardo Cluniacensi (testimonies concerning Aymard of Cluny) — no English translation found despite Aymard's historical significance. Peter Damian's accounts exist but no dedicated translation project identified.
Acta concilii Triburiensis (acts of the Council of Tribur, 895) — no English translation found. Specialized medieval ecclesiastical document not covered by major translation projects.
Acta conventus Attiniacensis (acts of the Attiniacum assembly) — no English translation found. Highly specialized medieval ecclesiastical proceedings.

Acta synodi Aquensis II (acts of the Aachen synod, second council) — no complete published English translation found. The Synods of Aachen (816-819) are well-documented in English scholarship but their full acts appear untranslated.

Acta synodi Aquensis (acts of the Aachen synod) — no complete published English translation found despite historical importance. Charles West's UTP book discusses Council of Aachen 862 but this refers to different synod acts.
Acta synodi Bellovacensis (acts of the Beauvais synod) — no English translation found.
Acta synodi Mettensis (acts of the Metz synod) — no English translation found.
Acta synodi Pontigonensis (acts of the Pontigny synod) — no English translation found.
Acta synodi Suessionensis (acts of the Soissons synod) — no formally published English translation found. References exist to Soissons councils in scholarly works but not complete translated acts.
Acta synodi apud Tolosam (acts of synod at Toulouse) — no English translation found.
Acta synodi apud Vermeriam (acts of synod at Vermeria) — no English translation found.
Acta synodus Pistensis (acts of the Pistoia synod) — no English translation found. This 9th-century synod is distinct from the better-known 18th-century Synod of Pistoia (1786).
Concilium in Verno palatio (council at the palace of Verno) — no English translation found.
Consilium ad Carolem II (counsel/advice to Charles II) — no English translation found.

Epistolae Tegernseenses (Letters from Tegernsee monastery, 12th-century collection) — only partial translations exist: 7 letters in Peter Dronke's Medieval Latin and the Rise of European Love-Lyric; 11 letters in German translation by J. Kühnel. No complete English translation of all 327 words found. H. Plechl's MGH critical edition (2002) is Latin only.
Testimonia veterum et recentiorum (testimonies of ancients and moderns) — no English translation found. Specialized collection of attestations likely appended to a major work.

Annales Hildesheimenses Quedlinburgenses et Lamberti (Chronicles of Hildesheim, Quedlinburg, and Lambert) — English translation completed by Bethany Hope Allen (UNH Master's thesis, 2007, won Research Prize 2008), available in UNH Scholars Repository. Status unclear whether published commercially or thesis-only; not in major published translation series.
Epistola ad Ebalum (letter to Ebal) — no English translation found.
Epistolae ad Joannem XIX (letters to Pope John XIX) — no English translation found.
